_comment: Reviewer CLI templates for the self-hosted C940 checker (cli-draft mode). The packet arrives on stdin; {schema} and {out} are substituted. An entry is used only when disabled is not true AND verifiedOn is set in a reviewed PR after the operator ran it on the C940 runner account. None is verified, so the runner refuses every PR until then.

grok.disabledReason: Relies on a 'do not use tools' prompt. Keep disabled until the CLI has a verified flag that removes tool use and the runner adds OS isolation (no network beyond the vendor API, no writable home).
argv: Review the packet on stdin. Reply with only the JSON object it asks for. Do not use tools.

gemini.disabledReason: Relies on a 'do not use tools' prompt; --approval-mode default still offers tools. Keep disabled until tool use is verifiably off and the runner adds OS isolation.
argv: Review the packet on stdin. Reply with only the JSON object it asks for. Do not use tools.
